text: Sheikh Chilli's Tomb is complex of structures located in Thanesar, in the Kurukshetra district of Haryana, India. It includes two tombs, a madrasa, Mughal gardens and various subsequent features.
best_time: October to March (pleasant weather, ideal for heritage monuments, wildlife, and cultural walks)
